preGeneration.rule: load common master + character + camera + drum + negative constraints
actionKey must match exact runtime action; no left/right inference when explicit
FAIL images excluded from positive learning
every active limb has target/instrument and strike/pedal coordinate

automaticPostGeneration.rule: character frame: arms=2 legs=2 hands=2 sticks=2; drum_base exemption: no character required
each stick intersects/attaches to exactly one hand grip; no orphan stick component
active stick tip or pedal endpoint inside target tolerance ellipse after overlay with fixed drum base
global character scale within ±3%; center ±10px; roll ±2deg
head/pelvis/stool/inactive limb/frame deltas within MASTER_GEOMETRY.temporal limits
no required anatomy/stick tip clipped by canvas unless explicitly whitelisted
novel near-solid black connected component >0.8% canvas area outside known clothing/boot masks triggers review
index/action/phase naming must match frame spec

visualPostGeneration: anatomy natural despite rough line style
no ghost limbs or alternate-pose residue
clothing continuity and irregular hand-drawn check pattern
hit/rebound pair reads as one continuous motion
fixed drum overlay alignment is believable

resultPolicy.SOFT_FAIL: repair unless visual QA proves measurement false
resultPolicy.PASS: only when both automatic and visual QA pass
